name: echo portal
description: Proposal, the Island's portal jump sampled beat for beat from its hatch.js: the creature glitches back in beside a hatch in the floor, steps up to it, crouches and heaves it open wide eyed as a magenta shaft floods up, hops in (the view cuts to over the pit), sinks feet first with the antenna last, and the hatch irises shut to a seam; judge whether the cut between the two shots reads as one jump and whether the shaft reads as light rather than a wall.
